# Danny Ahn — dannyahn.com

Danny Ahn is an AI-focused technology & data systems professional with 20+ years of experience across artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture. He builds intelligent, secure, scalable systems for organizations from Fortune 500 companies to emerging startups.

## Core Expertise
- Artificial Intelligence: machine learning systems, intelligent data pipelines, AI-driven security — turning models into production infrastructure
- Cybersecurity: threat analysis, vulnerability assessment, zero trust architecture, enterprise security for Fortune 500 companies
- Cloud Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, GCP; cloud-native design and deployment at scale
- Data Systems: pipeline architecture handling millions of events per second, database design for high-concurrency workloads (sharding, replication, consistency models)
- Enterprise Architecture: system integration, API design, microservices, technology stack optimization
- DevOps & Automation: production-grade Terraform/IaC, state management, CI/CD integration

## Career Highlights
- 2012 — Analyzed MGM Mirage's casino player club database and loyalty program infrastructure; identified vulnerabilities in enterprise data systems
- 2015+ — Enterprise cybersecurity with Fortune 500 companies: threat analysis and security architecture
- 2018+ — Cloud & infrastructure leadership for mid-market organizations
- 2021+ — AI-focused practice: applying machine learning to enterprise security, cloud infrastructure, and data systems

## Featured Guide
"What is an AI data systems architect?" — the full answer lives at https://dannyahn.com/ai-data-systems-architect.html. An AI data systems architect designs and oversees the end-to-end infrastructure that lets artificial intelligence run in production: machine learning pipelines, model serving platforms, real-time data foundations, cloud architecture, and the security controls that tie them together.
